flash_693379.description: IDF Spokesperson Effie Defrin provides an update from the Ali al-Taher Ridge in Lebanon: All of the terrorists who were inside the infrastructure were eliminated or fled.

flash_693383.description: Around 50,000 people attend late night Selichot service at the Western Wall. Rabbis and public figures pray for unity, the safety of Israel's soldiers and the recovery of the wounded.

flash_693382.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said it had received a report of two vessels being attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, approximately 6.5 kilometers west of Khasab, Oman.

According to the agency, the crew of another vessel reported seeing four unidentified missiles strike the two vessels. A fire broke out on one of them, while the condition of the second vessel was unknown. UKMTO reports indicate that several vessels in the area have been affected in recent days amid ongoing military operations.

flash_693380.description: Tens of thousands of worshippers arrive at the Western Wall Plaza in Jerusalem to take part in the final recitation of Selichot before Rosh Hashanah.

flash_693393.description: Britain did not recognize Israel until 1950, two years after its founding, and was among the last Western democracies to do so. Part of a pattern. Opinion.

flash_693392.description: Anthropic says it blocked users who tried to use its AI models for potentially harmful biological research, including work involving viruses and toxins.

flash_693390.description: IDF launches surprise drill in the Judea and Samaria Division as part of preparations for the upcoming holidays. All battalions mobilized, and increased security activity will be visible throughout the area.

flash_693388.description: Mohamed Ilyess Akodad sentenced to two years in prison for firebombing a Montreal synagogue after accepting a $15,000 arson offer.

flash_693386.description:
Russian President Vladimir Putin arrived in New Delhi, India's capital, ahead of the BRICS summit scheduled to take place this weekend. During his visit, Putin is expected to meet with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and hold additional bilateral meetings.

BRICS comprises Russia, Brazil, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Indonesia and the United Arab Emirates. The summit will be held in New Delhi on September 12 and 13.

flash_693385.description: Trump says he would make the same decision to strike Iran's nuclear sites, warning Tehran will not be allowed to obtain a nuclear weapon.

flash_693381.description: The US imposes new sanctions on Hezbollah and Iranian proxy networks as Washington expands its campaign to cut Tehran off from financial support.

flash_693411.description: Anonymous calls made by a bus driver repeatedly sent police scrambling over fears of terrorist attacks. Following an investigation, police succeeded in identifying and arresting him.

flash_693410.description: The Ministry of Environmental Protection announced that mosquitoes infected with the West Nile Virus were captured in Ashdod. The ministry instructed local authorities to expand prevention, monitoring, information and pest control activities on the subject.

flash_693409.description: Muhammad Yazouri, commander of Hamas’ Khan Younis Brigade, was eliminated in a precise strike along with two other terrorists. IDF: He had worked to advance dozens of attacks against Israeli troops.

flash_693407.description: Behind the scenes of one of the war’s most complex operations: Crossing the Litani River, face-to-face combat, prolonged underground fighting, and destruction.

flash_693405.description: Rachel Rabin Yaakov, sister of the late Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin and one of the founders of Kibbutz Manara, passed away Friday at the age of 102.

flash_693403.description: President Herzog: “Even 25 years later, the evil of that vicious assault on the United States remains as shocking as ever."

flash_693401.description: Axios reports that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman urged Trump to strike the Houthis as they advanced toward the Red Sea chokepoint of Bab al-Mandab. Trump refused.

flash_693399.description: Algeria announces it is severing diplomatic ties with the UAE, accusing the Gulf state of provocative and hostile actions. Abu Dhabi hopes the split is temporary.

flash_693397.description: Senior Fatah official Jibril Rajoub says PA legislative elections may not take place on Nov. 28, calling for national dialogue first.

flash_693395.description: Manhattan DA Alvin Bragg indicts Larry Montes over antisemitic attack that disrupted Shabbat services at Central Synagogue.

flash_693391.description: The Jewish people of tomorrow are growing up in the homes and classrooms of today.

flash_693389.description: CNN reports that more than 100 US military advisers are helping Saudi Arabia with intelligence and targeting as Houthi attacks raise fears of a new regional front.

flash_693387.description: A US official confirms a CBS report that an Iranian missile attack damaged an A-10 and about eight F-15s at a US air base in Jordan.

flash_693384.description:
Yoaz Hendel, chairman of the Reservists Party, approached Ofer Winter, chairman of the Amcha Yisrael Party, with an offer to sign a surplus-vote agreement, but Winter is expected to reject it, Kan 11 News reported Thursday evening.

However, Winter has not ruled out the possibility of signing a surplus-vote agreement with Itamar Ben Gvir's Otzma Yehudit party. Likud plans to pressure Ben Gvir to sign such an agreement later on, despite its negative stance toward Winter.

flash_693427.description:
Automatic Bank Services data: Israelis spent more than NIS 1.196 billion using payment cards on Rosh Hashanah eve, an increase of 3% from last year.

The busiest minute was recorded at 11:52 a.m., with more than 21,800 transactions totaling NIS 3.91 million.

flash_693426.description: The IDF is preparing for the possibility that Hezbollah will attempt to retaliate for the destruction of underground infrastructure beneath the Ali al-Taher Ridge, which was considered one of the terrorist organization’s strategic assets in southern Lebanon.

flash_693425.description: Panic erupted after a man realized his relative who was accompanying him in a kayak had failed to resurface, prompting an urgent call to rescue services.

flash_693424.description: Memorial ceremonies at the World Trade Center in New York City and in Shanksville, PA, mark 25 years since the deadliest terror attack on the US and remember the 2,977 victims.

flash_693423.description: About 70 Breslov Hassidim are reportedly in military jails after arrests ahead of Rosh Hashanah, as legal aid is offered to those returning from Uman.

flash_693422.description:
Yesterday (Thursday), the IDF and ISA struck in the Khan Yunis area and eliminated the terrorist Moamen Jabr Al-Sayed Abu Labda, head of a sniper cell in Hamas’ Rafah Brigade.

The terrorist carried out sniper training across the Gaza Strip aimed at harming Israeli civilians and IDF troops operating in the area of the Yellow Line. Recently, he attempted to reconstitute the terrorist organization's capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. He was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.

Prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munition and aerial surveillance.

flash_693421.description: IDF Chief Eyal Zamir warns Hezbollah against rebuilding its capabilities after troops dismantled a major underground terror network built with Iranian aid.

flash_693420.description: While the IDF officers’ school prepares for the High Holidays, Rabbi Eliad Kornberg highlights how its rabbinical training program connects cadets to their Jewish roots and identity.

flash_693419.description: I cannot promise my children a sweeter world in 5787, but I must promise them that we will not surrender our place in it. Jewish hope is not optimism, optimism says things will get better.Opinion.

flash_693418.description: Netanyahu marks 25 years since 9/11, draws parallel with October 7 massacre: 'We will never bow to terrorism. We will never surrender to evil.'

flash_693417.description: "When the world falls into the error of thinking that the goal of Emuna is already in its hand, at that very moment it begins to turn away from it."- Rabbi Avraham HaCohen Kook.

flash_693416.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz praises IDF troops following destruction of tunnels on Ali al-Taher Ridge: “We promised security to the residents of the north - and we delivered."

flash_693415.description: More than NIS 459 million was spent using credit cards in just three hours on Rosh Hashanah eve. Once again, Israelis head into the holiday with overflowing shopping carts and a faster pace of spending than last year.

flash_693414.description: A 70-year-old man was found dead in his home on HaGdud HaIvri Street in Tel Aviv, a few days after his death. His neighbors, who had come to his home to wish him a Happy New Year, feared for his safety after he did not answer their knocks on the door. ZAKA volunteers were called to the scene.

flash_693413.description: The Houthis have completed their takeover of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, one of the world's most important strategic shipping lanes, AFP reported.

flash_693412.description: MK Gotliv criticized the silence of Israel’s political and military leadership in the face of a film by Israeli filmmakers that presents a narrative claiming Israel deliberately harmed Gazans.

flash_693408.description: Security sources confirmed to Kan News this morning (Friday) that an attempt was made overnight to eliminate terrorist Muhammad al-Yazouri, the commander of the Khan Yunis brigade in Hamas.

flash_693406.description:
Last night (Thursday), IDF surveillance identified indications of activity in preparation for a smuggling attempt in the eastern border area.

Following the findings, forces from the Jordan Valley and Foothills Brigade, officers from the Israel Police Jordan Border Unit of the Judea and Samaria District, and Border Police forces in Judea and Samaria operated jointly and established ambushes in the area.

During the operation, two residents of Jericho were arrested. More than 30 pistols and two M-16 rifles were seized.

The suspects and weapons were transferred for further investigation by the Judea and Samaria District Central Unit.

flash_693404.description: Tens of thousands of Jews in 169 communities are preparing to celebrate the Tishrei holidays under fire. The CEO of the Federation of Jewish Communities of Ukraine tells Arutz Sheva about the many challenges they face.

flash_693402.description: Rosh Hashanah is the time for introspection with what we come before the Heavenly court.

flash_693400.description: The soundless voice of silence. What is it telling us?

flash_693398.description: A whole new world: Birthday blast for Adam, the first man.

flash_693434.description:
Trump marks 9/11 anniversary at Pentagon, linking the war on terror to the fight against Iran and vowing the US will never forget the attacks.

flash_693431.description: Balad Chairman Sami Abu Shehadeh warns of attempts by Zionist parties to recruit Arab voters, calling this a 'very serious danger' and states that his party will launch an 'organized campaign' to prevent votes from leaking to other parties.
